description: Add one user redirect rule to a site, such as forwarding a moved page to its new path. User rules are checked before the live deploy's `_redirects`, in list order: the rule goes at the end of the user rules, or at `position`. The status defaults to 301, a permanent move. It is added to the latest list, without a version. Returns the rule with its `id`, and the new version. Visitors get it within about 5 minutes; check it with `test_redirect`. Each call is a separate save, so for more than a few rules use `set_redirects` or `edit_redirects`. Redirects apply only on the organization's own custom domains (`CustomDomainRequired` otherwise).

from.description: Source path: exact (`/old-page`), with `:name` placeholders (`/blog/:year/:slug`), or ending in `/*` (`/docs/*`). No query string.

partition.description: Data partition the site lives in. Omit to use the user's home partition.

position.description: Where to add the rule among the user rules, from 0. Defaults to the end.

status.description: 301, 302, 303, 307 or 308. Defaults to 301, a permanent move. Use 302 or 307 for a temporary one.

to.description: Destination: a path starting with `/`, or an http(s) URL. `:splat` fills in what `*` matched, and `:name` a placeholder's value. The request's query string is carried over.

name: add_redirect
